description: Desktop app that plays customizable mechanical keyboard and mouse sounds, with sound profiles and per-application rules.
notes: The Windows download is an NSIS installer, not a dedicated portable package. Scoop extracts its nested app-64.7z payload instead of running the installer, so normal installer registration and uninstall integration are not applied.

The upstream project says Keyboard Sounds is no longer under active feature development and is maintained for bug fixes; development has moved to Keyboard Sounds Pro: https://github.com/keyboard-sounds/keyboardsounds-pro.
This manifest does not move the application's settings or custom profiles into the Scoop directory on D:.
